notes.title: New Mystery Vehicle Update
notes.notes:
[b]Mysterious Vehicle in Auto Sale Life World[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/595c1d69c5e5b91c393d88c097ba76f9a297dae5.jpg[/img]

A new mysterious vehicle has been added to the world of Auto Sale Life. Finding and owning this vehicle will not be that easy. This new vehicle, which can appear in mysterious locations in the city, also attracts attention with its different driving characteristics.

notes.title: Detailed Full Version Innovations Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]The Most Expensive Vehicle in Auto Sale Life Added to the Game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/0a22aeb54e4fe11c3fae48730801b64c23ef51fd.jpg[/img]

You have to be really rich and lucky to own this very rare vehicle :) Don't forget to try your luck at the Auction House.

[b]New Vehicles Added to the Game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/da2dff621f3b3cb10d5f4be0ac4b53d8bacde176.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/204cb02d0d9d30407860b46a1ec017665f6a4d54.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/4a2ff0966694dc1997f87fcf3a29a0b6340a54a1.jpg[/img]

With these new vehicles added, our players can expand their vehicle collections as they wish.


[b]Other Side of the City Opened[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/81cd5822c650fb643a3b89ad9a2a8fbe1a877320.jpg[/img]

The other side of the city, which was closed to access in the game, is now open for exploration for players who have completed the story part of the game. Also, don't forget to complete the small story quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/ceda229555643ce095b65dcfb233c5174931d83a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/38b6f54a5de419093517fd5dd0c511aa2e11dfac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/b3c67f24d4b54e41c6c99b6ff8b3232f2d5bf8b6.jpg[/img]


[b]In-Game Bugs[/b]

We receive complaints that some of our players encounter bugs in missions and some processes in the game and we are working to solve them as quickly as possible. If our players encounter an error, please let us know in detail and we will try to solve it as quickly as possible.

[i]It is very important for us to develop the game with you.[/i]

notes.title: Auto Sale Life Full Version Release
notes.notes:
[b]Auto Sale Life Full Version Meets Our Players on March 12th.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/e5503ccecc8bb1b12f01d98a233c3f313a2fbf0f.jpg[/img]

[b]What's New[/b]

- The variety of vehicles available in the game has been increased.
- The other side of the city is now open for players who have finished the game.
- Additional story mission added
- Bug Fix and performance improvements have been made.

notes.title: New Car and Driving Dynamics Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Cars Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/9fa1f12dcf06197c22e7def27af36301ae9cc7bc.jpg[/img]

Cars of 5 different types and classes have been added to the game with the new update. It is now possible to find these cars at Premium Garage, Auction House and Car Market.

[b]Driving Dynamics[/b]

The difficulties related to vehicle driving in the game have been edited and replaced with a smoother driving type.

In addition, some bugs that negatively affect the gameplay have been fixed with edits.

notes.title: Early Access Update Planning Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]New Cars Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/1b01b91bf6c84088d7c2be4c3efe5a8cf4bd69f3.jpg[/img]

We are planning to add 5 different new cars to our game with an update in a short time. We will continue to add more different cars with regular updates.

[b]New Showroom Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/540bae215622a8547d1f36d77d91e67f0cf5f7b4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/53c3bb852d2173e42337cbbac49da256e5ef794e.jpg[/img]

Soon we plan to bring a more luxurious showroom where you can display and sell more cars in the game.

[b]Closed Part of the City[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361172/1d513d81b3250b47841408c9a98ee8518e615660.jpg[/img]

We are seriously working on opening the city's closed bridge connection and bringing in new content. We plan to open the closed part of the city as additional content that unlocks with the completion of the story. As a small team of developers, you can rest assured that we are working hard to bring you the best experience.

[b]Car Handling[/b]

We plan to release an update on the difficulty of driving the cars in the near future. We aim to provide an easier and more realistic handling.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]

We will examine all the bugs you have reported to us in detail and solve them as soon as possible with mass updates, and we will do our best to minimize the negative experiences you have in the game.

notes.title: Auto Sale Life Early Access BugFix Patch
notes.notes:
Hello. All feedback from our player community is very valuable to us. So we would like to thank all our players for their feedback and support.

Fixed broken interior camera angles.
Adjustments were made to the first carjacking mission.
Fixed the issue with the expertise report being difficult to view.
Fixed issues with not being able to join the race
Fixed Roger not showing up for some players
Some cars have been physically modified.
Fixed auction vehicle delivery issues.
Fixed junkyard car sale bugs.
Fixed Tommy mission regeneration issue.
